messages:
Sam (eng-platform): Morning async — preflight check. Ran a canary burst test against gw in eu-west and hit intermittent 429s around ~1.6k RPS. Can't reproduce in staging with the same load profile. Blocker: need token-bucket metrics + envoy stats from the canary pods. Today: I'll pull logs and ping infra for node metrics. @Maya @Ben any quick thoughts?

Maya: Thanks — can you paste the exact load command and which route policy you targeted?

Sam (eng-platform): Load command I used:
```bash
hey loadtest -c 1000 -r 1600 'https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/ent' --header 'Authorization: Bearer token'
```
Targeted route: /v1/ent (public read paths), policy: `route-policy-public-v3`.

Ben: I pushed a small tweak in PR #402 — bumped `burst_size` 200 -> 500 for a few internal routes, but that was for internal traffic only. Not sure it affects public endpoints. PR link: https://git.redwood/eng-platform/pulls/402 :eyes:

Lia: FYI we saw similar behavior last month when KV cache miss + cold containers caused request processing to slow, draining token buckets and triggering 429s. Two quick options: enable a short prefix-KV cache for /v1/ent or temporarily raise the per-route token weight. I can open a 10% canary change for the cache tweak.

Maya: Also check envoy metric `upstream_rq_429` on the canary pods and whether the JWT rotation job ran during the test window — it ran unexpectedly last week and caused auth refresh storms.

Sam (eng-platform): Good call. I'll grab envoy stats and pod logs and drop them in #incidents if there's a pattern. Trying a narrower repro against a single backend shard to isolate: 
```bash
wrk -t12 -c400 -d60s https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/ent/replay
```

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T09:12Z: canary rollout started for service `api-gw` v2.0.7 -> 10%

Ben: If we need an emergency mitigation we can add a fallback route to a lighter path or route heavy clients to Dedicated capacity temporarily. Not great long-term but buys time. :thumbsup:

Sam (eng-platform): Plan: 1) grab envoy stats + node metrics and post findings in #incidents, 2) try Lia's cache tweak on canary, 3) coordinate with infra to watch token-bucket counters during the next burst. ETA ~90m. Leaving notes in PR and will follow up here. Thanks everyone.
